text: Entry Requirements Applicants should have graduated from High school or above. Applicants should be holding a non-Chinese nationality. Applicants should abide by the laws of China and the Rules & Regulations of Shantou University. An HSK-4 (or above level) certificate is required for all Chinese-taught bachelor’s programs, except for the program of teaching Chinese to speakers of other languages. Students who do not meet the requirements of Chinese language can apply for a program of Chinese Language Course to study the Chinese language.
